fato_historico: 1988: Hurricane Gilbert devastates Jamaica; it turns towards Mexico's Yucatán Peninsula two days later, causing an estimated $5 billion in damage.
energia_do_dia: The stars suggest that your intense spirit may encounter transformative winds today. Much like the resilient flora that regrows after a fierce storm, you might feel a shift in your emotional landscape. It is a good time to clear away what no longer serves you and prepare your heart for a season of beautiful, steady growth and deep personal renewal.
frase_do_dia: Even after the strongest winds, the most vibrant flowers find a way to bloom.
significado_numero: Represents the infinite flow of power and cyclical renewal in your life.
conselho: Consider grounding yourself today to stay steady amidst any unexpected changes or emotional shifts.
